Attached image 1: the concept sheet of my game "Hold On!" — style reference only. Attached image 2: the concept sheet of the world where this enemy lives — match its palette and light. Attached image 3: the player character of the game — match its art style exactly: chunky rounded shapes, a thick dark navy outline around the silhouette, flat cartoon toon shading with one soft shadow tone, light from the upper left, simple black oval eyes. Do NOT copy layouts, text or UI from the attachments.

Create ONE character model sheet of an ENEMY for a 2D side-scrolling co-op platformer. Landscape 3:2. Plain flat light grey background (#E6E8EC), no scenery, no ground texture. On the left: the enemy large, full body, in strict side view facing right. To its right, in one row, smaller and evenly spaced: the same enemy in each pose listed below, all in strict side view, with exactly the same design, colors and scale. Next to the large view stands a tiny simple red bean-shaped character for scale (see Size). The enemy has a thick dark navy outline like the player character; cute, rounded, funny, readable as a small sprite — friendly cartoon, NOT scary, no gore. Dangerous parts (teeth, claws, spikes) have a small red warning accent. Its colors must not match the pure red, blue, yellow or green of the players. No text, letters, numbers, labels, arrows, frames, logos or watermark.
Enemy: a stocky round workshop beetle with a copper-bronze shell and a wide flat top (a player can stand and ride on its back) and a big flat bulldozer-like plate on its head for pushing; short sturdy legs; it crawls along platforms and shoves players off edges.
Poses: crawling; pushing hard (leaning forward, legs braced); stopped by a wooden crate in front of it (surprised); turning back at a ledge edge (one foot over the edge, startled); carrying the tiny red character standing on its back.
Size: as tall as the player character, about two characters long.
Neutral white balance. Keep all requested poses or states distinct, complete and fully visible, with generous spacing. All miniature states share one scale; the left primary view is larger. Frozen characters are stone-grey versions of the bean character, with identical limbs and outline. No extra scenery.

edits.prompt: Keep everything the same, but correct ONLY these details: beside the large left beetle, enlarge the red scale character until its full height equals the beetle full height; the beetle is about two character widths long. All other beetle views face right. Remove the floating red and navy exclamation-like marks above the poses. Keep plain FLAT light grey #E6E8EC background, no vignette or gradient. Preserve the beetle design, colors, thick navy contour, arrangement and all five poses. No text, labels, arrows or symbols.
